"""
GTO Data Change Detection System

A system for maintaining data integrity through automatic change detection
and comprehensive documentation.

Example Usage:
    ```python
    import pandas as pd
    from gto.core.setup import install_dependencies
    
    # Install required packages
    install_dependencies()
    
    # Regular pandas read_csv is automatically monitored
    df = pd.read_csv('my_data.csv')
    ```
"""

import pandas as pd
from .core.setup import install_dependencies, verify_installation
from .docs.generator import generate_documentation



[docs]
def demonstrate_functionality() -> None:
    """Show how the system works with a simple example."""
    # Ensure dependencies are installed
    install_dependencies()
    
    # Create test data
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "id": [1, 2, 3],
        "value": [100, 200, 300]
    })
    df.to_csv("test_data.csv", index=False)
    
    # First read establishes baseline
    print("\n[Initial Data Load]")
    print(pd.read_csv("test_data.csv"))
    
    # Modify data
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "id": [1, 2, 3],
        "value": [110, 210, 310]  # Values increased by 10
    })
    df.to_csv("test_data.csv", index=False)
    
    # Second read shows changes
    print("\n[Data Reload After Changes]")
    print(pd.read_csv("test_data.csv"))
    
    # Generate documentation
    generate_documentation()



if __name__ == "__main__":
    demonstrate_functionality()
